card.name: Astronomy text: numbers and names
card.fires_on: Words in astronomy passages, mostly the space or digits before a number of degrees or years, and first names or nationalities before an astronomer's name.

modes.label: Numbers in sky geometry
modes.description: The space or digit just before an angle or period, in text about the ecliptic, equinox or precession.

modes.label: Astronomer name lead-ins
modes.description: A first name, title or nationality right before an astronomer's surname.
